label: New Mexico Wastewater Collection System Level 1 (CS1)
purpose: Practice questions for the New Mexico Wastewater Collection System Level 1 (CS1) written certification examination, technical outline only. Original items in US units. Not an official NMED examination or blueprint. Regulatory items are limited to 20.7.4 NMAC clauses that do not depend on population band, permit, reporting timeframe, fee or site. Contains no certification-level classification, permit, reporting, site-specific or emergency-response content.
reviewIntro: 250 original practice questions: 195 conceptual (including 8 Regulations items from 20.7.4 NMAC) and 55 calculations, in US customary units. Scope is the technical content of the March 2026 CS1 Operator Guidebook. No 20.6.2 NMAC or NPDES items: the guidebook names those rules but no clauses within them. This is a local content package, not proof of a production import.
